descriptionChirho: An elevated room on the upper story of a building, used for private devotion, lodging, or assembly (e.g., Elijah's loft, Daniel's prayer room, the Shunammite's guest chamber).
The celestial upper chambers of God, built above the waters of heaven, from which He waters the mountains (Psalm 104:3, 13; Amos 9:6).
The way of ascent or stairway by which one goes up to a higher place, as Solomon's ascent to the house of the LORD (1 Kings 10:5 / 2 Chronicles 9:4).
